mentions.name: RGBloom
mentions.description: Service for creating printed photo books in minutes for a flat £10 including delivery, currently UK-only, available via a web app plus recently launched iOS and Android apps. Privacy-first by design: no accounts required, optional email is wiped after 30 days, and minimal data is kept for as short a time as possible, with transparent honest pricing and no large delivery fees at checkout.
mentions.problem: Photo book services typically require accounts and email addresses, retain personal data, and hit customers with large delivery fees and opaque discount pricing at checkout.
mentions.source_excerpt: RGBloom: create printed photo books in minutes (UK only for now) for just £10 including delivery. Been working on this for 8 months, recently launched iOS and Android apps to go alongside the web app.

mentions.name: RGBloom
mentions.description: A privacy-focused online photo book builder, available in the UK only for now. It requires no sign-up, collects minimal details (email optional), stores photos locally in the browser's IndexedDB, sends nothing to the server until the user goes to print, does no tracking, and deletes all data within a month.
mentions.problem: Privacy and tracking concerns with conventional photo book services that upload and retain photos on their servers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a photo book system that respects privacy via no tracking, not sending anything to the server until you go to print (all stored in indexeddb until then) and even then requires as few details as possible (eg email address optional), and no sign up at all. Then everything deleted within a month. It's at https://www.rgbloom.com/ and UK only for now.
